$comment: Screen D's four gods, copy verbatim. Perks are data: xp is a fraction per skill, extraDrops rolls one more table per successful cycle of that skill, doubleYield is the chance a cycle lands twice, combat is the boon favour buys in a fight (Phase 7; numbers checked by scripts/tune-boons.ts).

name: Tharok
title: the Deep Delver
description: God of stone, ore, and stubbornness.

combat.name: Stone Skin
combat.line: Your skin takes the hill's view of things.

name: Vessith
title: the Verdant
description: Goddess of growth and green things.

combat.name: Green Return
combat.line: What is cut grows back. Slowly. You too.

name: Maren
title: of the Still Water
description: Goddess of tides, patience, and lunch.

combat.name: Still Hand
combat.line: The water does not hurry. Neither does your hand. It lands.

name: Ashkar
title: the Everburning
description: God of flame and poor impulse control.

combat.name: Ember
combat.line: What you hit stays hit, and a little singed.
